trap.label: pergunta indireta com did
trap.wrong: Could you tell me how much is the fine? Do you know when did you return it?
trap.right: Could you tell me how much the fine is? Do you know when you returned it?
trap.why: O português não tem auxiliar do/did em perguntas, então o brasileiro o mantém ao transferir a ordem direta. Em inglês, na pergunta indireta o did some e o verbo vai ao passado.

mcq.q: Could you tell me how much ___?
Direct: “Why did she leave?” Indirect: Why ___
Which is correct? (pergunta indireta com did)
opts: I wonder how old he is.
I wonder how old is he.
I wonder how old does he.

fix.right: Do you know when he arrived?

fix.right: Tell me how many books there are.

fix.wrong: Can you say why did you go?
fix.right: Can you say why you went?
